cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says judgments or case status are open to the public online.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-12, 2 to 4: the Judicial Service counted about 75,829 cases filed on e-justice by January 2025 (GHA-003), and lawyers file online through it (GHA-004). The December 2025 rollout report (GHA-001) does not say it stopped, and nothing says the public can look cases up.
